tasks.title: Status adopts bounded shared reads and proves the API poll refuses redirects
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, Shared finding, all Behavior bullets and Completion evidence; Rollout order 2, Performance impact, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 5. After contract merges, record/reuse the same merged main SHA as the other consumers. Keep pin, lockfile, local poll regression and runtime documentation together; verify the existing browser dist-module allowlist.

acceptance.expected: Run new native-fetch regression on old pin 1b5e7d3e268372a6241db05ae30272eab7299b10 and retain intended assertion failure, then on fixed pin: all tests pass, 0 fail. Local /checks answers 302 to a second 127.0.0.1:0 server; poll records error rather than ok and destination receives 0 requests. Use injected poll timers; stop poll and close servers. Focused coverage exit is not the gate.

All tests pass, 0 fail; /pulse-contract/client.js and /pulse-contract/version.js return 200, and settings-poll's redirect case still counts exactly 3 reads. Inspect imports of fixed contract dist/index.js and its modules against existing src/server.ts allowlist: every imported module is served without a new allowlist entry. Focused coverage exit is not the gate.

acceptance.command: bun install && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, both typecheck projects including e2e, full tests and unchanged >=80% line coverage pass.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- package.json bun.lock README.md
acceptance.expected: Only the contract dependency line changes in package.json, to github:lorenzh/pulse-contract#<full merged main SHA containing #864/version 2.5.2>; bun.lock resolves that same SHA. Verify the merge on contract main independently and record/reuse the shared finding from the first consumer so probe, status, notify and console adopt the same SHA. Commit package.json and bun.lock together; other pins stay unchanged. README says every API request follows no redirect, server-side Bun reads refuse compressed answers, and browser poller decoding runs inside the 5 MiB cap.

acceptance.command: bash -c 'TIMEFORMAT="%U %S"; for run in 1 2 3; do time bun run test; done'
acceptance.expected: Run on main and candidate, three runs per side on one machine; report each user+system sum and median. Spec expects status.test_cpu_s delta <+0.1 s. Use bash builtin time, not absent /usr/bin/time.

Run if implementation changes more than the planned pin/tests/docs adoption. First clone pulse-api into <scratch>/pulse-api outside status and bun install --frozen-lockfile there; it owns bench/run.ts. Use identical concrete api main SHAs on both sides, target status, --others-ref main and a publicly fetchable candidate ref. Docker with Compose is required; report status rows against the API-owned budgets.
exit 0 with installed Playwright Chromium; existing status browser/accessibility checks pass against the adopted contract.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && gh pr view --json body,statusCheckRollup
acceptance.expected: Whitespace exits 0 and repository-required CI checks, including browser/accessibility, pass. PR records full merged contract SHA and shared-finding provenance, check results and the applicable Security impact checklist: fixed secret-safe diagnostics, bounded bodies, redirect protection and full-SHA/lockfile consistency. No new dependency or setting. PR records old/new poll regression outputs, unchanged module allowlist, 3-read settings control, CPU medians and applicable fallback rows; state the browser identity/streaming-decoder limit.
